baby: The circle of life begins with fertilization and blastocyst formation in the womb.
mother: Your body begins quiet, miraculous work preparing to nourish new life.
tip: Stay well-hydrated and start your doctor-recommended folic acid supplement.

baby: A tiny primitive heart begins beating and the foundation of vital organs takes form.
mother: A missed period comes with profound emotions, tenderness, and fatigue.
tip: Celebrate this sweet start. Schedule your first prenatal appointment and rest.

baby: Active reflexes: baby curls tiny toes and opens and closes their fingers.
mother: First trimester concludes and your gentle baby bump begins to show.
tip: A wonderful week for your first trimester scan and celebrating this milestone.

baby: Halfway there! Baby actively swallows amniotic fluid and kicks distinctly.
mother: Your uterus reaches the level of your belly button. You feel clear fluttery kicks.
tip: Time for the 20-week anatomy scan to check every wondrous developmental detail.

baby: 1 kilogram milestone! Baby experiences REM dream sleep and blinks smoothly.
mother: Welcome to the third trimester. Breaths may feel slightly shorter.
tip: Rest on your left side to maximize oxygen-rich blood flow to baby.

baby: Lungs are mature and preparing for that first breath in your arms.
mother: Baby drops lower into the pelvis, relieving rib pressure but pressing on your bladder.
tip: Keep your hospital bag, birth plan, and documents easily accessible.

baby: Fully ready to meet your eyes, hear your voice, and rest skin-to-skin.
mother: Your due date has arrived. Trust your body's strength and instinct.
tip: Breathe gently: you are powerful, capable, and so close to holding your baby.
